posts.content_html_raw:
Itsmezof said:
Reading this thread makes the game seem really complicated to start.

Im fairly new to this VN thing and i was recommended to play this one. Is there any tips or things i should take into consideration before i start playing it?

Like i said it seems pretty complicated to make the events to start, in right order and with right affection
Click to expand...
Personally, the biggest tip is to pay attention to what is being said or shown. It will come in handy later on. Of course there's a Wiki:
https://lessonsinlove.wiki/index.php?title=Main_Page
and a Puzzle guide on the first page to help if you get stuck, anyway.

If the grinding for affection or lust, which tends to be required in increments of 5, is too much, I recommend URM:
https://f95zone.to/threads/universal-renpy-mod-1-15-2-mod-any-renpy-game-yourself.48025/
If you find the game too bright, you can try the Dark Mod on the first page, and if you want to just get rid of the dialogue box, then I recommend this Ren'py transparency mod:
https://f95zone.to/threads/renpy-transparent-text-box-mod-v2-6-3.11925/

Overall:
  • Plot comes first.
  • Get to know everyone, even those you don't like.
  • Do as you please, but expect some choices or actions to come back later on for better or worse.
  • If you want to experience everything, then you might need multiple playthroughs and multiple saves. However you want to do it.
  • The game can be a little fucked up, and I would expect things to get worse down the road. Not exactly a happily ever after kind of story.
  • Before you download any care packages or dlc, which are just unnecessary bonuses, be aware of DRM, and how you are risking your saves adding them to the game.
Also, this thread enjoys talking about the game, theories, characters, and story, etc, so if you don't want to be spoiled, it might be better to wait until you've caught up to watch this thread.

Most importantly, make multiple saves so the option of going back to points of no return is available.

Otherwise, just enjoy and read the story and see if these contents are your cup of tea. If you like it then I'm sure you can conjure whatever efforts necessary to keep the story progressing without worrying too much about how complicated it definitely is.

Guys, we have completed one mod here that combines the ability to change the theme in real time from light to dark and back through the main menu and also adds the ability to put absolutely any menu picture by simply putting it in a folder.

Installation, just drop game folder into the youpathgame folder

Upload your images for the menu to the folder GAMEPATH\game\mods\customizationmod\your_menu_image

In main menu chooses "Change menu pictures" for to select images and "Change game theme" for change dark(A Lady of the night Kirin) or light(Classic) themes.

If you plan to delete a mod then make sure that you have a light theme selected in order to avoid errors

The mod was tested in the Russian segment and on some original versions. There was 100% functionality everywhere, but in case something still won't work, please write me this. We will be grateful for the feedback.

posts.content_html_raw:
My perception of Maya's and Sensei's relationship has completely changed now due to some of the recent revelations.

It was my initial belief that despite Maya having known Sensei since she was a kid, they had only begun being truly intimate when she entered highschool the first time. However clearly that relationship started much earlier than that , likely while he was still tutoring her. Knowing now that Sensei was also groomed by his tutor when he was a child, this makes what I perceived to be a simple budding highscool romance into something much darker. I wonder if that's likely the reason Sensei couldn't mentally handle having sex with Maya in prior cycles. It pulls him to close to the parts of himself that he cannot accept.

This also changes how I perceived Sensei's pre-mindmelt characterization, as I was under the assumption he would have never actually pursued a physical relationship with his students if he still had a full personality but that obviously isn't the case. What used to be one of the most wholesome relationships in the game is now anything but. Very interested in how things will develop.

posts.content_html_raw:
Does anyone have a good take on why this sentence "Then I will continue to praise myself so your disdain for me may grow as if it is a tree" set Sensei off? I am scarcely on the same page with Sensei with the I wonder why?

The scene flashes with a tree jpeg from trinity Pt1 if you've seen it prior to triggering Watermelons and Violin, but that's about it. I don't think this is a case where Maya simply cites an old analogy she or Sensei made for describing something, as Maya has always been careful not to do that. So what does tree, or maybe that tree in particular, mean to him?

One can assume tree here is associated with religion stuff, hence Sensei's overall distaste in the matter. However, Sensei didn't have any strong reaction when he saw the actual tree, and I don't remember if Sensei ever made the association between tree and god, or anything from the past in that matter, while displaying clear negative emotions
(I also have doubts on if Sensei at all is able to associate tree with god or not. It feels like a player thing and not his).

Or maybe he just doesn't like anything that starts with T?

I feel like this has a chance of being something more, and not just a comedic running gag that doesn't need to be answered.
For example, Sensei is against the idea of Ayane saying teacher-time as some kind of innuendo. It wasn't until after a second playthrough plus some future revelations that I thought "Ah, it might be him subconsciously rejecting anything that reminds him of Sekai". I think Sensei's sudden anger towards that sentence is like this, but for now I don't know what it is insinuating.
